Total, mean, best, worst and range describe accuracy, while the sample standard deviation SD and coefficient of variation CV describe how repeatable the group is. Read them together: a high average with a large SD means the result came from luck, so work on a repeatable position rather than chasing single high shots. Pick the scoring system first since it changes the reference values. Everything is computed locally.
